description: This Python pipeline constructs energy-benchmarking inputs for South Korean medical institutions. Jihyun Oh publishes code that joins building-register records, energy billing, Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service information and weather observations into a 2018–2021 institution panel. It handles single-building and multiple-building configurations separately, applies quality filters and combines the results into a released CSV view with 85 columns representing 37 variable types. Outputs include a column dictionary, stepwise counts and validation figures. The pipeline converts monthly billing to annual site and primary energy measures; it does not publish a common subhourly load series. Code is freely available under MIT, with version 1.1.0 archived on Zenodo in September 2026. A limitation is that three historical source versions are no longer available from their public portals, and the actual manual exclusion list is not distributed. Reproducing the published counts therefore requires independently obtaining the inputs and repeating that inspection. No released institution-level data table was verified in this repository. Simulation uses include building-energy archetype calibration and hospital demand comparisons. It relates to model-energyplus. The tool was inspected through its documentation and file tree, without executing it.
